method: Frame excerpts from original local AAC/H.264 files using AVFoundation. Requested approximate video offsets only; capture manifests do not bind encoded timestamps to game clock.

limitations: This samples actual frames. Thermal smoke and fireball contrast are subtle from the reviewed distance, and sampled Ground frames do not strongly establish smoke contrast. Native emitter/trail and contact receipts are separate. Full cinematic review, 30° operational effect legibility, covered/earned-opening readability and matched-volume audio are unrun.
